SILT#00047: Went down a rabbit hole for how enums are defined in Python, specifically how `auto` function works. One thing to note is that there is an EnumType metaclass, which handles defining how the Enum class gets defined, which then trickles into the custom enum. Learn more on the enum docs at: https://docs.python.org/3/library/enum.html
